cards.card_text: Then Job says, "My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God." Ouch, friend.
cards.verse_text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
cards.snippet: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.

cards.card_text: scoffers and fools priests and kings widows and orphans
cards.verse_text: How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
cards.snippet: How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?

cards.card_text: Wisdom keeps asking the simple ones and the scoffers and fools "How long" they'll go on this way.
cards.verse_text: How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
cards.snippet: How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?

cards.card_text: Now the word of the LORD comes for the scoffers who rule the people in Jerusalem, because they said, "We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol." Out of EVERYBODY in the world to sign a deal with, they picked DEATH.
cards.verse_text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: He ends with a warning: watch out that what the prophets said doesn't happen to you, words aimed at scoffers about a work God is doing in their days.
cards.verse_text: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish!
cards.snippet: …was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish!

cards.card_text: The prophets' warning to scoffers is about a work God is doing in their days.
Then Peter gets to the most important part: in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
cards.verse_text: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
cards.snippet: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

cards.card_text: Scoffers following their own ungodly desires A great famine across the land Angels walking openly among people
cards.verse_text: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
cards.snippet: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
